metadata.title: Connecting Steamer Services
metadata.caption: Undermentioned liners are thoroughly equipped with the latest facilities for the comfort and safety of passengers. Wireless telegraphy is installed on each steamer, and a qualified doctor is also on board. 1. Dairen-Tsingtao-Shanghai Line: The Dairen Kisen Kaisha's mail and passenger boats (3,749-4,018 G. Tons) sail every two days and arrive at the terminal port on the third day. 2. Dairen-Tientsin Line. This line is also maintained by the Dairen Kisen Kaisha. The passenger boats (1,270-2,352 tons) sail every one or two days covering the distance in 24 hours. 3. Dairen-Moji-Kobe Line. The Osaka Shosen Kaisha's mail and passenger boats (5,167-8,188 G. Tons) sail almost every day, covering the distance from Dairen to Moji in 43 hours. 4. Yuki-Seishin-Tsuruga Line. The Kita-Nippon Kisen Kaisha's mail and passenger boat (3,054 G. Tons) sail three times per month, covering the distance in 47 hours. 5. Yuki-Seishin-Niigata Line. The Nippon-kai Kisen Kaisha's mail and passenger boats (2,130-2,346 G. Tons) sail three times per month, covering the distance in 54 hours.
